note: A concept is not an objective. Coverage is reported only for the references an audit actually inventories; a partial inventory is never extrapolated to the whole specification. A lesson file is not a teaching sequence, a teaching sequence is not an assessment, and one assessment item is not complete assessment coverage. The assessment stage separates items existing, some published requirements covered, and all requirements covered.

audits.verdict: NOT REVIEWED — assessment exists but no educator has signed it

objectives.gap: No AQA-style assessment; no learner evidence.
Comparison symbols are used in prose, not assessed as a separate skill.
Multiplication has a sequence; addition, subtraction and division do not. All four concepts are excluded from Higher, where AQA can assess N2.
The decimals lesson covers place value, conversion and multiplication; addition, subtraction and division of decimals are not taught. Higher excludes place-value.

assessmentRequirements.statement: Add proper and improper fractions, including different denominators.
Subtract proper and improper fractions, including different denominators.
Multiply proper and improper fractions.
Divide a mixed number by a proper fraction and express the quotient as a mixed number.
Interpret a fractional quotient in context: state the whole batches and the mass left over.

objectives.gap: All five published operation requirements now have an assessment item; no educator review and no learner evidence.
No AQA-style assessment; no learner evidence.

assessmentRequirements.statement: Add and subtract negative fractions after writing them with a common denominator.
Multiply and divide negative fractions, deciding the sign before calculating.
Order negative fractions by position, using a common denominator to compare them.

objectives.gap: The lesson now teaches negative fractions and all three assessment requirements have items. It has not been reviewed by a teacher or tested with learners; the Higher tier still needs a separate check that the concept is offered at the demand that tier expects.
Financial mathematics has a plan but no teaching sequence or assessment.
Inverse operations are taught inside equation solving, not as the arithmetic relationship N3 asks for.
The order-of-operations sequence exists but roots and reciprocals are not established. Higher excludes order-ops.

assessmentRequirements.statement: Use the vocabulary of factors and multiples, including recognising a factor and a multiple of a given number.
Identify all the common factors of two numbers.
Find the highest common factor of two numbers.
Find the lowest common multiple of two numbers.

objectives.gap: All published N4 factor, multiple, common-factor, common-multiple, HCF and LCM requirements now have an item; no educator review and no learner evidence exist.

assessmentRequirements.statement: Write a whole number as a product of its prime factors.
Use index notation for a repeated prime factor.
Explain the uniqueness of prime factorisation, apart from the order of the factors.

objectives.gap: All published prime factorisation, product notation and uniqueness requirements now have an item; no educator review and no learner evidence exist.
